purpose: Read-only protocol and identity qualification around the existing Oslo locator. No production/global configuration was changed and no polygon was added.

source.advertisedVersion: WFS 2.0.0 only in the current GetCapabilities document
source.defaultResponse: application/gml+xml; version=3.2 request is accepted and returns text/xml; subtype=gml/3.2.1 with GML 3.2 namespace

schemaPropertiesRelevantToRead.observedIdentityMapping: gml:id teig.N suffix equals app:identTeig/app:teigId N for all three current Oslo sample records and the exact-ID readback.

storedQueries.caveat: A successful real-ID response has an app:Teig document root rather than wfs:FeatureCollection; a synthetic valid-range ID returns HTTP 403 OperationProcessingFailed. Do not infer no-data from that error.

alternateEndpointReview.restrictedServiceHandling: Catalog marks this separate Matrikkelen WFS as restricted access; it was not queried and no access restriction was bypassed.
alternateEndpointReview.otherPublicDistribution: Catalog also lists Geonorge download/INSPIRE feed distributions; they are file/feed routes, not a verified alternate bounded WFS query endpoint.

catalogCaveats.serviceFreshness: Geonorge describes a daily extracted dataset, with delay possible after large changes.
catalogCaveats.geometryCaveat: The catalog says curves may be delivered as LineString/Kurve and may be deformed by transformation. The bounded Oslo sample uses native EPSG:25833 surface/polygon GML; this audit does not validate every national geometry encoding.
catalogCaveats.license: CC BY 4.0 in the public service catalog; not treated as a technical gate.

boundedOsloEvidence.polygonCapPolicy: No additional geometry was persisted. The pre-existing three-polygon file remains the sole Norway geometry sample.

queryFindings.projectionFinding: Response still included standard Teig properties such as identTeig, oppdateringsdato, område, kommunenummer, kommunenavn, matrikkelenhet, matrikkelnummerTekst, teigMedFlereMatrikkelenheter, tvist, uregistrertJordsameie and uuidTeig. Values outside public ID and geometry were discarded in memory.

queryFindings.pagingFinding: The one-record page at startIndex=1 matches the second ID in the bounded count=3 response. Offset paging works for this bounded check; each data page still misreports numberReturned.

queryFindings.filter: FES 2.0 Intersects on app:område with a native EPSG:25833 polygon using the fixed Oslo locator bounds.
queryFindings.countDiscrepancy: The KVP BBOX hit count (74) differs from the exact FES Intersects hit count (82). The same FES filter returns three feature members on a count=3 data page; these hit counts should not be conflated or treated as a validated complete population.

queryFindings.geometryFinding: The single native-ID readback reproduces the existing sample geometry exactly; no polygon copy was saved.

queryFindings.identifierShape: teig.<integer>; within the declared integer type range
queryFindings.interpretation: Explicit absence for this single native-shaped resource ID under the public RESOURCEID filter only. This is not evidence of missing coverage for any area.
Malformed/out-of-range ID caused an HTTP 500. This is a request error, not absence.
The advertised stored query uses an error response for this unknown ID; it is not a successful empty result and must not be interpreted as absence.
Identity lookup succeeds, but its response shape is rejected by the current FeatureCollection-only GML reader.

queryFindings.realIdResult: HTTP 200 empty FeatureCollection for teigId 291142538 despite that ID being present in the bbox and RESOURCEID results.
queryFindings.interpretation: This property filter did not match a known real ID, so its empty response does not establish absence. RESOURCEID was the only successful exact filter demonstrated.

reasons: backend/parcels/gml-wfs-source.js has only fixed Lodz, Dresden and Poznan profiles; descriptor validation rejects any other profile/schema.

backend/parcels/gml-parcel-reader.js custom schemas are restricted to the three existing schemas, and it rejects a FeatureCollection when numberReturned differs from parsed featureCount. Kartverket reports numberReturned=0 on data responses with one or three real members.

The existing exactIds implementation builds a FES PropertyIsEqualTo filter on the configured property. The observed nested teigId property filter fails even for a known real ID; a Norway profile would need the working WFS RESOURCEID mechanism.
Stored GetFeatureById works for a known ID but returns a bare app:Teig root, not the FeatureCollection expected by the parser.
The exact FES Intersects hit count is available (82), but the KVP BBOX hit count differs (74); all-page consistency has not been qualified.

Geonorge documents possible curve geometry and transformation deformation; the current three Oslo Polygon samples do not prove that all nationwide geometry is supported by the existing Polygon/PolygonPatch reader.
readerCompatibility.assessment: The published endpoint demonstrably supports bounded native-CRS geometry reads, one correct RESOURCEID readback, a valid-range empty RESOURCEID response, and startIndex paging in the Oslo sample. The existing fixed-profile reader cannot consume it without a Norway-specific schema and narrowly scoped protocol handling. The current count mismatch, filter behavior and curve caveat make this evidence insufficient to enable a runtime profile; do not treat the source as qualified for broad city ingestion yet.
